acceptance_limits: Unchanged AP on partial modeled hardware; synthetic reset/setup fixtures remain explicitly recorded.
GPU draw/pixel counters establish software rendering work, not every requested effect.
Duplicate frame-file samples are not animation or dynamic-background verification.
Peak child-tree RSS does not establish leak-free memory stability.
IRQ completion/status reads do not prove full original guest ISR coverage.
No startup-batch gestures, reentry, sensor controls or deliberate sleep/wake cycles.
